title: Constant algebraic completion and its finite coefficient diagram
statement: Let $X,Y$ be schemes, $g:Y\to X$ a morphism, and $d$ an adic coefficient datum on a commutative ring $A$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Put $C=\widehat A$. The evaluations $C\to A/I^{n+1}$, constant sheafification, and the coefficient comparisons of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower] give a cone from the constant $C$ ring sheaf to the actual finite coefficient diagram on $X$. Its inverse-image projections $r_n$ satisfy $r_m q_{mn}=r_n$ for every $n\le m$. Define $a_g:D(C)\to D(g^{-1}\underline C_X)$ by the exact constant module functor followed by exact inverse image [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. This construction uses the constant algebraic completion ring, not the completed sheaf of coefficient rings.
